count_method: Unchanged direct-transfer-v1.0.0; fixed baselines, chronological forward/backward evaluation and independent count protocol approval. AI/synthetic results cannot qualify.
opportunity_method: Unchanged native-opportunity-v2.0.1 regional reports reconstructed from exact reviewed campaigns and original file binding. Required dates include every day of every eligible comparison month; exact ordered source/target cohorts, fixed region, no duplicate reports.
support_rules: Complete requested ROI/date/cohort support, independent processing/geometry review, and nonzero known AND usable area in every season and exact cohort. This is minimum support, not a claim that opportunity differences are negligible or that unknown area is acceptable. Each explicit standard-cohort native platform also needs measured known/usable acquisition-cell support in every season, with shared mask/companion group identities deduplicated and invalid geometry groups retained explicitly. Acquisition-cell area is not a regional daily denominator. Platform evidence is restricted to the exact report region and cohorts; lack of positive detections cannot remove a platform from the gate.
conclusions: Separate owner-verified independent conclusions bind evaluation hash and explicitly assess target/partitions, measured opportunity changes, unknown support with rationale, seasons/platforms, permitted claims and limitations. No manually supplied passed summary replaces recount.
permitted_scope: Retrospective direct overlap comparability only; no new blind-confirmation claim for inspected records. Qualified historical deployment needs separate source-era opportunity/applicability protocol and evidence; pre-VIIRS observations are never invented. No forecasts, factor chains, observation overwrite or synthetic detection locations.
